In this video, I travel 2,400 km in just 7 hours on the world’s longest high-speed rail route from Beijing to Guangzhou aboard the world’s fastest bullet train in China, experiencing the most luxurious Business Class and the most expensive train ticket I’ve ever bought.
Join me as I showcase the incredible speed, luxury, onboard experience, and fascinating facts about China’s world-class high-speed rail network.
